Priya: Heads up — I'm heading to an unexpected clinic appointment and need someone to take primary for the 18:00-22:00 UTC window. I have the pager till 17:45 UTC. Can anyone pick up the primary handoff? :calendar: :wave:

Marco: I can take the 18:00-20:30 slot but have a call at 20:30. If someone can shadow 20:30-22:00 that works.

Tara: I can do the 20:30-22:30 handoff; switching from secondary to primary OK? Need a quick sync on outstanding alerts.

Priya: Thanks both. Marco — super, please do warm handoff to Tara. Quick notes: there's an active perf/regression alert for embeds latency in eu-west with elevated tail latency (p95 ~ 2.1s last 30m). Not page-firing now but keep an eye. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeds-latency (see the checklist and mitigation steps).

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager event cleared: EMBEDS_LATENCY_HIGH — status: acknowledged by Priya — cleared at 17:34 UTC. Related incidents: none active.

Liam: Quick heads-up: Dedicated capacity A (eu-west-1 pool) has a partial node restart from the maintenance window, might reheat some docker layers. Observability shows a small tokenization spike earlier. Nothing to action unless it recurs.

Marco: Copy. I'll audit the per-model serving metrics and keep the KV cache hit rate dashboard up. If p95 > 2.5s I'll escalate. Which corp prompt set should I test against for regression checks?

Priya: Use corp-embeds-v2 (promptset id corp-e2). Steps I usually run: 1) run a small batch against canary model variant, 2) check /metrics/runtime/kv_cache_hit, 3) check redis TTLs for prefix cache. Snippet I run locally: ```bash
# quick synthetic run
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.test/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-v2-canary","input":["sample text 1","sample text 2"]}' | jq .
```

Tara: Got it. Marco, if you see p95 creep and canary fails, flip to fallback model variant `embed-v1-stable` policy for that route (we have automatic fallback in routing but we want manual now). I'll be ready to roll a canary rollback if needed.

Marco: Roger. Also adding runbook pointer to my notes: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeds-latency#manual-fallback. Do we want to pre-warm the stable variant before swapping?

Priya: Yes, pre-warm for ~3 minutes with 20 synthetic queries to avoid cold start hits. Use the prewarm job in infra-tools: `infra-tools prewarm --pool eu-west-1 --model embed-v1-stable --count 20`.

Oncall Scheduler: @Marco assigned as primary for 18:00-20:30 UTC and @Tara assigned as primary for 20:30-22:30 UTC. Shadow/secondary assignments: @Liam (18:00-22:30 UTC).

Marco: I started the dashboards and kicked off a small prewarm to warm stable variant (see logs). Will post back on any anomalies.

Tara: Thanks — I'll be on watch at 20:15 to take an in-person handoff. Quick checklist request: Priya, any open runbook TODOs I should know?

Priya: Two items: 1) confirm no in-flight canary rollouts in the last 24h (I rolled out a tiny experiment at 02:00 UTC, but it was limited). 2) notify infra if prewarm triggers >3 worker restarts in 5m (that's a sign of node instability). Both are low-prob, but call infra@pager if you see repeated restarts.

Liam: I'll keep infra on alert and subscribe to relevant logs. Also added a quick query to watch for restart churn: ```promql
sum(increase(kube_pod_container_restarts_total[5m])) by (node)
```

Marco: Noted. If anyone's taking notes, add the recovery play for tokenization regressions: 1) toggle tokenization flags in routing layer, 2) fall back to stable tokenizer, 3) open a tracking issue.

Tara: Will do. Also please add me to the corp-e2 test run results and the slack thread when you kick synthetic runs (so I can validate outputs quickly).

Marco: Sending results to this thread once prewarm + synthetic runs complete. 

Priya: Thanks everyone — appreciate the cover. Marco -> warm handoff to Tara at 20:25 UTC, please do a short 5-minute walk-through in thread with anything outstanding. I'll be reachable by DM if needed. :thumbsup:

Tara: Copy that. See you both later.

Marco: Prewarm done, synthetic run p95=1.1s on stable variant, canary still at 2.0s but not rising. Posting logs excerpt: ```
[2024-08-04T17:50:12Z] model=embed-v1-stable prewarm ok, 20 requests, avg=0.9s
[2024-08-04T17:52:07Z] model=embed-v2-canary p95=2.03s, kv_hit=0.87
```

Tara: Looks healthy. I'm ready to take over at 20:30, Marco — ping me 5 min before handoff for the short summary.

Oncall Scheduler: Handoff complete: Marco -> Tara at 20:30 UTC. Primary coverage updated in rota. :white_check_mark:

Priya: Thank you team. If anything changes, please escalate as per the runbook. Closing my coverage now. :v:

incident-bot: Incident summary appended to thread: EMBEDS_LATENCY_HIGH — root cause: transient cache miss spike correlated with maintenance node restarts — status: monitored (no active pages).
